summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares UltraPro MidCap400 (UMDD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Mid Cap 400 index. The fund provides 3x exposure to a market cap-weighted index of 400 mid-cap companies. UMDD was launched on Feb 11, 2010 and is issued by ProShares.

holdings.infoBox: UMDD is an equity ETF with a total of 410 individual holdings. The top holdings are Cash stock at 20.38%, S&P Midcap 400 Index Swap at 17.07%, U.S. Dollar For Futures at 1.96%, Cte Proshares Trust M at 1.67%, and Twilio at 0.85%.
